messages:
Anya Patel: quick design check — console Help panel wording + link behavior. dropping in screenshots and notes. https://imgur.com/abc123

Mike Chen: looked at the mock. quick notes: 1) 'Docs' vs 'Help' inconsistent across console; prefer 'Help' for the panel label. 2) external links should open in new tab, internal should stay in-app. 3) close button needs aria-label.

Lina (UX): Agreed on terminology. Proposed microcopy: "Need help? Open the Help panel for quick tips, examples, and links to relevant Docs." For external links use target="_blank" + rel="noopener". Add aria-label="Close help panel" and ensure focus trap. Example:

```
<button aria-label="Close help panel">×</button>
```

Jamal Ortiz: analytics note — append ?src=help-panel to links so we can distinguish traffic. For external links ok to open in new tab; add `link_source` event in telemetry.

docs-bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4321 — updates help panel copy + aria attributes. @Lina please review :eyes: 

Lina (UX): Reviewing now. UX nit: put primary docs link above feedback so discoverability is higher. Also show keyboard shortcut hint (`?`) at the top-right. For a11y, ensure panel is announced: `role="dialog" aria-labelledby="help-title"`.

Mike Chen: also a layout thing — on < 480px the docked panel covers the bottom action bar. Can we slide over instead of pushing? tagging eng-runtime.

Anya Patel: plan: Jamal adds tracking + link params; Mike to log the layout bug with eng-runtime; Lina will PR the microcopy tweaks; I'll merge the docs PR after Lina approves. Thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
